'''Quingarus''' was a [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory owner.

==Biography==
Quingarus owned the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory)|planet]] close to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. They took up a loan with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the organization later threatened them to build a [[Upgraded battle droid|new type]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] for the Banking Clan to repay Quingarus' debt.

Quingarus refused to switch their production lines to suit their demands, complaining that their family would starve as a consequence. They were saved from their battle droids by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had landed in the factory to get his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] repaired. Kenobi convinced them to accept [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] aid by making an agreement to have all the Republic's astromechs maintained at Quingarus' factory, thus helping them pay back their loan easily.
